root_cause.text: The kfree() call for rocker_port->wpriv was incorrectly placed after an early return statement that executes when the port_post_fini callback is NULL, causing memory allocated in rocker_world_port_pre_init() to never be freed for operations that don't implement the callback.
root_cause.evidence: The patch shows the original code structure had `if (!wops->port_post_fini) return;` which prevented execution of the subsequent `kfree(rocker_port->wpriv)` statement. Since rocker_ofdpa_ops has a NULL port_post_fini callback, this early return was always taken, leaving the wpriv memory (allocated via kzalloc in pre_init) unreleased. The fix inverts the condition to `if (wops->port_post_fini)` and removes the early return, ensuring kfree() executes unconditionally regardless of callback presence.
